label: H.R. 9770
title: Continuing Appropriations Act, 2027

items.snippet: This bill provides continuing FY2027 appropriations for federal agencies and extends various expiring programs and authorities.

items.item: Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)
items.snippet: For example, the bill includes exceptions for the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC);

items.item: Federal Emergency Management Agency’s Disaster Relief Fund
items.snippet: the Federal Emergency Management Agency’s Disaster Relief Fund;

In addition, the bill extends several expiring programs, authorities, and restrictions, including the Department of Agriculture’s livestock mandatory price reporting program, the National Flood Insurance Program, limits on pay increases…

…and restrictions, including the Department of Agriculture’s livestock mandatory price reporting program, the National Flood Insurance Program, limits on pay increases for the Vice President and certain senior political appointees, the Temporary…

…Program, limits on pay increases for the Vice President and certain senior political appointees, the Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) program, the authority to waive certain pay limitations that apply to wildland firefighters and other…

…Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) program, the authority to waive certain pay limitations that apply to wildland firefighters and other wildland fire personnel, the authority for the District of Columbia to spend local funds, and the…
…the District of Columbia to spend local funds, and the freeze on cost-of-living adjustments for Members of Congress.
The bill also provides the customary payments to the beneficiaries of the late Representative David Scott and the late Senator Lindsey Graham.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.
